Persia, Cush, and Put{d} are with them, all with shield and helmet,
Gomer with all its battalions, Beth-togarmah{e} from the remotest north with all its battalions—a host of peoples go with you.
"'Be ready; make yourself ready, you and all the companies mustered around you, and be their guard.{f}

After many days you will be summoned.{g} In the latter years you will come against a land restored from the sword, whose people were gathered from many peoples onto Israel's mountains, which had long lain in ruins. Its people were brought out from the peoples, and now all of them live securely.
You will go up, advancing like a storm; like a cloud covering the land you will be, you and all your troops and many peoples with you.
"'The Lord Yahweh says this: On that day thoughts will rise in your mind, and you will devise an evil scheme.
You will say, "I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will fall on a quiet people who live in safety, all of them dwelling without walls, with neither bars nor gates,"

to seize spoil and carry off plunder, to turn your hand against ruins now resettled and against a people gathered from the nations, who are acquiring livestock and goods and live at the center{h} of the earth.

Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish{i} with all its young lions{j} will ask you, "Have you come to seize spoil? Have you assembled your company to carry off plunder, to take away silver and gold, to seize livestock and goods, to take great spoil?"'
"So prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog: 'The Lord Yahweh says this: On that day, when my people Israel are living securely, will you not take notice?{k}
You will come from your place in the far reaches of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a great horde and a mighty army.

Like a cloud blanketing the land, you will advance on my people Israel. This will happen in the last days: I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when through you, Gog, I show myself holy before their eyes.
"'The Lord Yahweh says this: Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days through my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?
On that day, the day Gog comes against Israel's land, declares the Lord Yahweh, my fury will flare up in my nostrils.
In my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I declare: On that day there will surely be a great earthquake in Israel's land.

The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the beasts of the field, every creeping thing that creeps on the ground, and every human being on the face of the earth will quake before me. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs{l} will topple, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will summon a sword against him on all my mountains,{m} declares the Lord Yahweh; every man's sword will be against his brother.
With plague and bloodshed I will enter into judgment with him. I will rain down on him and on his troops and on the many peoples with him a torrential downpour, hailstones, fire, and sulfur.
Thus I will display my greatness and my holiness and reveal myself before the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.'

notes.text: Gog is otherwise unknown. Some link the name to Gyges (Gugu), a seventh-century BC king of Lydia in western Asia Minor; in Ezekiel he is a ruler of the far north who leads the nations against Israel in the last days (compare Rev 20:8).
Magog appears among the sons of Japheth in Gen 10:2. Here it seems to mean "the land of Gog."
Or "the prince of Rosh"; Hebrew nesi rosh. The Greek takes Rosh as a name ("Rhos"). Also in v. 3 and 39:1. On Meshech and Tubal, peoples of central Asia Minor, see the note at 27:13.
Cush is the Upper Nile region, south of Egypt; Put is probably Libya.
Gomer is usually identified with the Cimmerians, and Beth-togarmah with a region in eastern Asia Minor (compare 27:14).
So the Hebrew; the Greek has "you will be a guard for me."
Or "mustered"; or "punished."
Hebrew "the navel"; compare 5:5.
The Greek has "Carthaginian merchants." On Tarshish see the note at 27:12.
Or "its young warriors"; the Greek has "all their villages."
So the Hebrew; the Greek has "will you not rise up?"
Or "the terraces"; the Hebrew word is rare.
Hebrew uncertain; the Greek has "I will summon every terror against him."

verses.text: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: 'The Lord Yahweh says this: I am coming against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
I will turn you around and drive you on,{a} bring you up from the far reaches of the north, and lead you against Israel's mountains.
Then out of your left hand I will knock your bow, and out of your right I will dash your arrows.
On Israel's mountains you will fall, you and all your troops and the peoples with you. I will hand you over as food to every winged scavenger and to the beasts of the field.
In the open field you will fall, for I have spoken, declares the Lord Yahweh.
Fire I will send on Magog{b} and on those who dwell at ease in the coastlands, and they will know that I am Yahweh.
"'My holy name I will make known among my people Israel, and I will no longer let my holy name be profaned. The nations will know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.
It is coming! It will surely happen, declares the Lord Yahweh. This is the day I have spoken of.

"'Then those who live in Israel's towns will go out and make fires of the weapons and burn them—small and large shields, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears. For seven years they will make fires of them.

They will not need to gather wood from the field or cut it from the forests, for they will make their fires of the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Lord Yahweh.

"'On that day I will give Gog a grave site there in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers,{c} on the east side of the Sea.{d} It will bar the travelers' way, for there Gog and all his horde will be buried, and it will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.{e}
For seven months Israel's house will be burying them, to cleanse the land.
All the land's people will take part in the burying, and the day I display my glory will win them a name, declares the Lord Yahweh.
They will set apart men to pass continually through the land, burying those{f} left lying on the ground, so as to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will begin their search.
As they pass through the land, whenever anyone sees a human bone, he will set up a marker beside it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
A city too will be named Hamonah.{g} So they will cleanse the land.'

"As for you, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says this: Say to every kind of bird and to every wild beast: 'Assemble and come! Gather from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, a great sacrifice on Israel's mountains, where you will eat flesh and drink blood.
The flesh of warriors you will eat, and the blood of the earth's princes you will drink—as if they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.{h}
At the sacrifice I am laying out for you, you will gorge on fat until you are sated and drink blood until you are drunk.
At my table you will be filled with horses and riders,{i} with warriors and soldiers of every kind, declares the Lord Yahweh.'
"I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment I carry out and the hand I lay on them.
From that day on, Israel's house will know that I am Yahweh their God.

And the nations will know that Israel's house went into exile for their iniquity, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their foes, and all of them fell by the sword.
As their impurity and their rebellions deserved, I dealt with them and hid my face from them.
"So the Lord Yahweh says this: Now I will turn back the captivity{j} of Jacob and show mercy to all of Israel's house, and I will be zealous for my holy name.
They will forget{k} their disgrace and all the unfaithfulness they showed me, when they live securely on their own soil with no one to frighten them.
When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from their enemies' lands, I will show myself holy through them in the sight of many nations.
Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God, who sent them into exile among the nations and then gathered them to their own soil, leaving none of them behind there any longer.{l}
Never again will I hide my face from them, for I will have poured out my Spirit on Israel's house, declares the Lord Yahweh."

notes.text: The Hebrew verb is found only here; the Greek has "guide you."
The Greek has "on Gog."
Hebrew Oberim; or, with a slight change, "the Valley of Abarim," the mountain range east of the Dead Sea.
That is, the Dead Sea.
Meaning "Gog's horde."
Meaning "horde." The Hebrew of this clause is difficult; the Greek has "the name of the city will be Burial-place."
Hebrew "the passers-by, those left"; the Greek lacks "the passers-by."
Bashan, east of the Sea of Galilee, was famed for its cattle (compare Amos 4:1).
Or "chariots."
Or "restore the fortunes."
So many interpreters, with a slight change of vowels; the Hebrew has "They will bear."
